report.summary: Impact between car-0 and car-1 occurred at t = 4.808 s, with timing uncertainty about 0.045 s. From t = 3.608 to 4.608 s, car-0 travelled at 49.7 km/h (90% interval 46.4 to 53.0) and car-1 travelled at 30.3 km/h (90% interval 28.5 to 32.6). The claim by s1 about speed for the white car was not consistent with the footage, while the claim by s2 about speed for the blue car was consistent with the footage. The claim by s2 that the white car showed no sustained braking before impact was consistent with the footage.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; frames the recorder dropped were placed using the vehicles' own motion.
Road calibration error: 0.611 m (how well the clicked road points fit a flat road); positions assume a flat road.

The momentum check after the impact did not balance (inconsistent): after contact the vehicles overlap in the image, so post-impact motion is not reliable. Speeds before the impact are measured separately and are not affected.
